column1: # Size budgets for the ark release binaries (audit row D6).
# Columns: name <TAB> cargo profile <TAB> features <TAB> budget bytes <TAB> measured bytes <TAB> command
# name          — the build name used in docs/BUILD.md and in this table
# profile       — `release` (opt-level="s") or `slim` (opt-level="z", see the workspace Cargo.toml)
# features      — `default`, `none` (--no-default-features) or an explicit comma list of `ark` features
# budget        — ceiling in bytes; tools/size-budget.sh fails when a build exceeds it
# measured      — size measured on 2026-11-05 (a clean target dir, same tree as the numbers in docs/BUILD.md)
# command       — the exact command that produces the binary (target/<profile>/ark)
